# Alberto Cortegana Alonso

> Portfolio of Alberto Cortegana Alonso, a game programmer from Spain finishing a Higher National Diploma (HND) in Game Programming at ESAT, Valencia. Focused on gameplay programming, with experience in Unreal Engine 5 (C++) and Unity (C#).

## Projects

- [Puppeteers](https://albertocortegana.com/projects/puppeteers.html): online co-op 3D puzzle-platformer in Unreal Engine 5 and C++, team of 3. Online sessions with Epic Online Services, lobby system and session browser, replicated ragdoll, replicated sprint VFX.
- [Procedural Voxel Game](https://albertocortegana.com/projects/procedural-voxel-game.html): infinite Minecraft-style voxel world in Unity 6 and C#, made solo in 10 days for the AEVI DevContest. Chunked terrain from 2D Perlin noise with face culling, caves and ore veins from 3D Perlin noise, physics-free player movement, real-time terrain editing, seeds.
- [EDK Engine Reimplementation](https://albertocortegana.com/projects/edk-engine.html): core modules of ESAT's C++/OpenGL teaching engine rewritten by a team of 3 and used to build a 3D scene. Fly camera, post-processing pipeline (underwater effect), particle system, Dear ImGui debugging tools, GPU and memory management.
